name: Pasta
message: 「Lord Virus has been so cold to me lately, nya...」

name: Ardin
message: 「Pasta-cha~n\s04 Forget that boring crap and come play with me!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I only wanted to cheer him up 'cause he looked down, and he told me to go home--that's way too cruel, nyaaa~~\s06」

name: Ardin
message: 「That bastard Virus, I won't forgive him! Hurting my sweet Pasta-chan like this!」

name: Ardin
message: 「And I sure as hell can't leave a wounded Pasta-chan all alone!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Pasta-chan! Let's go back to the Demon World together!」
